issues.on_page: Charges for services 204,772 (General 109,937 + Street 1,675 + Other Governmental 93,160)
issues.issue: The statement line holds General Fund Licenses and permits 15,345 (p21 Total column: Licenses and permits 15,345 + Charges for services 94,592 = 109,937) and Nolde Trust Fund Rent 93,160 (p19). The detail records these as licenses and permits and Rentals, so the receipt line and the detail lines are categorized differently. Kept as printed, which is defensible.

The label names a source (Nolde Trust), so 'other' may not be the best fit; donations/contributions is possible. The Statement of Activities (p3) counts it in general revenues 'Miscellaneous' 98,654 (90,000 + Other income 8,654), which supports leaving it as other. The same applies to detail[24].

The grantor comes only from the fund name CDBG. Under the 2026-11-12 FY2022 ruling, grant lines with no printed grantor are category other / Grants. Defensible because CDBG is a federal program. The same applies to detail[138].

The Statement of Net Position (p1) shows governmental notes receivable of 65,990 current and 265,147 noncurrent, and no new LB840 debt is shown. That points to repayments received on loans the city made (Loan Repayments). The question is already in decision_needed.

This is a billing and collection function, not clearly a contract service; utilities or other may fit better. The matching detail lines (Light, Water, Sewer) have detail_category 'not itemized', which does not match this category.
General office expense is not clearly supplies. It is a judgment call.

The function comes from the fund name (Street Fund), not from a printed function. The FY2022 ruling of 2026-11-12 says 'function only when printed'. The Sales Tax and CDBG capital outlay lines were left without a function.
